title.zh: Meta、Sierra给AI Agent做「通行证」，Walmart、Shopify等参与制定
title.en: Meta、Sierra给AI Agent做「通行证」，Walmart、Shopify等参与制定

current_state.zh: Meta and Sierra launched the Personal Agent Protocol (PAP), a standard for verifying personal AI agents' identity and user authorization with Walmart, Shopify, Stripe and others co-developing it, while competitor Decagon open-sourced its comparable PACT protocol and joined the PAP working group.
current_state.en: Meta and Sierra launched the Personal Agent Protocol (PAP), a standard for verifying personal AI agents' identity and user authorization with Walmart, Shopify, Stripe and others co-developing it, while competitor Decagon open-sourced its comparable PACT protocol and joined the PAP working group.
